limitations: Three trials per tool; the five-tool cohort covers only three order positions. Public-network variation remains material.
Zero-helper and one-helper results come from different cohorts and are not directly pooled or ranked.
Helpers require a strong ETag and known decoded length. No automatic helper-count adaptation, production pause/cancel integration or helper-body retry is implemented yet.
The diagnostic rejects unknown decoded lengths and supports at most 1 TiB.
The twenty runtime cases verify expected successes and expected failures; the short-primary-alone and short-both cases intentionally fail without false completion.
No new package, deployed version or GUI behavior is verified by this diagnostic.
